I managed to get some subsidized NPK fertilizer from the agro-dealer, though not as much as I would like, because rice needs some feeding to yield well. I will use my saved seed from last season, as improved seed is hard to find and costly, and my family will do most of the work since cash is tight and I cannot get credit.
